policy_record.comparison: Actual pre-Autumn-Budget policy versus selected native current-law measures, on the same native October 2026 forecast. This record changes policy parameters only.

bus_fare_cap_2027.note: DfT announced the £2 cap for January to December 2027 on 22 July 2026. It was already pre-Budget policy and is kept on both sides; this registered measure has no additional effect against actual pre-Budget policy.

carers_allowance_earnings_taper.note: Native start 6 October 2030 is the model assumption until DWP confirms the date.

cash_isa_limit_kept.note: Keep the model's £20,000 overall ISA limit, age rule and separate cash-interest charge. Only undo the cancellation of the £12,000 cash sub-limit.

domestic_electricity_zero_vat.note: Actual pre-Budget law: Great Britain already has 0% from October 2026 through March 2027; Northern Ireland has 5%. Only the April–June extension is reversed.

fuel_duty_rise_deferral.note: Pre-Budget snapshot da31e8698: statutory January/March 2027 steps, petrol/diesel 60.03p April 2027 then October RPI. Both sides state the unchanged rates from 6 April 2026 so the first scored fiscal year has complete coverage. LPG and natural gas preserve that snapshot's full rates after March; adding missing RPI to them is a separate reference change.

machine_games_duty_rise.note: Native threshold/classification switch; standard and higher statutory rates remain 20% and 25%.
